description: A loop start whose workspaceRoot the daemon cannot honour is REFUSED before anything is pinned (S19 T7 typed the validator): relative, invisible, or not-a-directory all answer the same code, and the retry is never the advice — resending changes nothing. The message names the specific fact the daemon could not verify.

error.message: the workspace is not usable by the daemon

data.means: the daemon validates what a loop may touch BEFORE pinning it; a loop pinned to an unreachable root would block on its first step anyway, with less context
data.todo: send an absolute path the daemon's process can see (same filesystem, existing); `aeon loop start` checks the same rule from the CLI
